scope: Prospective source-only review; no semantic inference, admission witness or measurement-contract revision
blind_sequence: Technical source/boundary/duplicate validation only; no opportunity census
Brian freezes natural inventory and queue without displaying candidate/match counts
Codex independently reads full canonical main sources and freezes census/references without reading inventory/candidates
Only then match frozen references against sealed inventory
Review actual matched targets/envelopes and source context; report geometric, required-span and compatible-target counts separately
matching: Unchanged frozen complete-role/required-source-span matching; declared literal aliases only. No authored geometry rescue or post-match reference changes.

per_reference_review.compatible_hit_requires: At least one naturally materialized candidate passes BOTH target compatibility and provenance-context review against the frozen reference. G3 whole measured utterance must support a coherent act/source/recipient interpretation; merely containing an embedded act is insufficient. G2 distinct complete roles must permit the claimed explanation to be evaluated without assigning unrelated or incompatible source material to the anchor.
disallowed: Do not narrow a mixed natural target manually and count the authored narrower span as discovery
Do not transfer reported acts to current-preacher credit
Do not mark a whole target compatible solely because its envelope names all speakers
Do not use one geometric window as multiple certified atomic acts with conflicting namespaces
Do not count unreviewed candidates as compatible
Do not drop frozen references, composite targets, controls or sparse cells after matching

denominator_policy: Preserve all independently frozen definite compatible opportunities. Ambiguous, incompatible and unavailable opportunities are disclosed separately before matching; do not change definitions after seeing recall.
candidate_queue_review: Review every frozen future semantic-queue unit against its exact request target/envelope before any later execution decision; mixed or unresolved units stay disclosed/quarantined, never silently replaced with reference-authored positives.
coverage_review: Review naturally matched candidates until a compatible target/envelope is evidenced, or disclose that a compatible alternative is unestablished. No unreviewed geometric alternative can establish PASS; exhausted review budget or unresolved coverage yields HOLD rather than inferred success.
metrics: Candidates, density, frame/envelope distributions, structural deferrals and control contacts
Active review timing only if actually measured; manual envelope-repair fraction and unresolved review-deferral rate; unknown is not zero
gates: Existing aggregate floors and .80 recall targets unchanged. Per-source .80 gates apply only to cells with >=5 definite compatible opportunities; smaller cells diagnostic. A decisive raw upper-bound failure stops before providers. Upper-bound success alone is not PASS; unresolved target/envelope sufficiency is HOLD. Preserve existing review-budget/burden criteria; no operational PASS from source-only geometric volume.
source_review_authority: Source-only evaluative judgment, not automatic provenance attestation, sealed-receipt admission authority, pastor ownership or production authorization.
